name: Glock 17 Velocity Muzzle Brake

name: M16A1 Flash Hider

name: M1A Flash Hider
description: This standard-issue muzzle device for the M14 and M1A is designed to suppress visible muzzle flash without altering the rifle’s recoil profile. Its design makes it well-suited for low-light conditions and operations in dense vegetation where concealment is critical.

name: M1A Muzzle Brake

name: M4QD Flash Hider

It also serves as a platform for attaching a sound suppressor.

name: M590 Salvo 12 Choke Adapter
description: The Salvo 12 Choke Adapter serves as both a choke and suppressor adapter. It allows compatibility between the shotgun and the Salvo 12 suppressor, providing quieter shooting and customizable choke options for enhanced performance and versatility.

name: M590/M870 Tactical Muzzle Brake
description: A tactical muzzle brake for the Mossberg M590 and Remington M870 shotguns. Its ported design redirects propellant gases to help reduce felt recoil and muzzle rise.

name: M590/M870 Tactical Muzzle Brake (Raven Team)

name: M700 Thread Cap

name: M870 Salvo 12 Choke Adapter
description: The Salvo 12 Choke Adapter functions as both a choke and a suppressor adapter. It enables compatibility between your shotgun and Salvo 12 suppressor, resulting in quieter shooting while also providing customizable choke options for improved performance and versatility.

name: MCX 3 Prong Flash Hider
description: Crafted from high-quality steel and coated in a sleek black finish, the Sig Sauer MCX 3-Prong Flash Hider is a fast-attach suppressor that minimizes flash and muzzle climb, thus enhancing the firearm’s performance.

name: Mosin-Nagant Howling Raven Muzzle Brake

It is secured in place by three brass set screws. Made in America from steel with a black oxide coating, this muzzle brake significantly reduces recoil.

name: Mosin-Nagant Tanker Muzzle Brake
description: The M44 Tanker-style Bolt-on Muzzle Brake is made of durable steel and has a robust construction with a heat-treated, erosion-resistant black oxide finish. It has side and top ports that minimize muzzle flip, recoil, and barrel whip, enhancing shooting stability and control by efficiently redirecting gases.

name: MP5 3 Lug Adapter
description: This adapter enables users to add 3-lug attachments, such as flash hiders, compensators, suppressors, and silencers, to their MP5.

name: MP5 Muzzle Cap
description: The MP5 Muzzle Cap is a protective accessory that covers and safeguards the MP5's muzzle. It prevents damage to the muzzle threads and keeps debris out of the barrel when the firearm is not used.

name: MP5 Threaded 3 Lug Adapter
description: Designed to provide versatility in attaching various muzzle devices such as suppressors, flash hiders, or compensators to an MP5 or similar firearm, this adapter typically combines a threaded section with the traditional 3-lug system found on the MP5.

name: MP7 Flash Hider
description: The H&K MP7 flash hider reduces muzzle flash, preserving night vision and minimizing the weapon's visible signature. It is constructed from high-quality steel and features a durable melonite finish for enhanced longevity and performance.

name: PCAM4-72
description: The PCAM4-72 features a triple baffle design, which significantly reduces recoil. Precision-canted side vents eliminate muzzle climb, ensuring minimal movement and reduced dust signature when prone. Built for durability and impact resistance, it features a lightweight design that can withstand combat conditions without rapid erosion.

name: QDC MAMS Brake 5.56x45
description: A steel muzzle brake for 5.56×45mm rifles with 1/2×28 threads. It reduces recoil and muzzle rise. It is compatible with KAC QDC suppressors.

name: Sa vz. 58 Zendl Compensator

It features CNC-cut lateral ports that help reduce recoil and muzzle rise, keeping shots on target during rapid fire. Heat-treated for durability, it performs reliably under harsh conditions. The compensator installs easily on the threaded barrel, enhancing control and accuracy for a more disciplined, combat-ready setup.

name: Sa vz. 58 Zendl Compensator (Blackwood Division)

It features CNC-cut lateral ports that help reduce recoil and muzzle rise, keeping shots on target during rapid fire. Heat-treated for durability, it performs reliably under harsh conditions. The compensator installs easily on the threaded barrel, enhancing control and accuracy for a more disciplined, combat-ready setup.

name: SKS Muzzle Brake Adapter

name: Slot Muzzle Brake

Precision-machined from hardened stainless steel, it features a tapered crown and a closed bottom to minimize dust kick-up.

It includes multiple bearing surfaces for proper alignment and a shim kit for correct installation.

description: The “Tanker” muzzle brake has six large side ports angled at 45 degrees, which effectively reduce recoil and stabilize the rifle. It also has six smaller vertical ports that reduce muzzle rise, allowing for faster realignment and more precise follow-up shots.

name: Vulcan F1
description: A flash hider designed for 5.56x45mm caliber firearms. Manufactured by ANTREG, a trusted name in firearm accessories, it effectively mitigates muzzle flash, reducing the shooter's visibility and maintaining their position covert while also serving as a platform for attaching a sound suppressor.

name: Vulcan M1
description: A device engineered to enhance the performance of 5.56x45mm caliber firearms. Designed by ANTREG with efficiency in mind, this muzzle brake effectively reduces recoil and muzzle rise, allowing for improved accuracy and faster target acquisition. It also serves as a platform for attaching a sound suppressor.

name: X-Factor Choke
description: This precision-engineered accessory enhances shotgun performance. Its ported design reduces muzzle jump and recoil, allowing for faster follow-up shots and increased accuracy. Featuring an Improved Cylinder constriction pattern, it guarantees an optimal spread tailored for close-range targets, rendering it well-suited for hunting and tactical scenarios demanding swift, precise shooting.

name: XM177E2 Moderator Flash Hider
description: This early flash hider for 5.56x45mm caliber weapons effectively reduces muzzle flash, improving shooter visibility and reducing the risk of giving away their position in low-light conditions. Originally manufactured by Colt in early 1967, this particular model was consistently utilized on the XM177E2. However, production of the Moderators by Colt ceased in the mid-1970s, following a ruling by the ATF categorizing the device as a sound "suppressor."
